title: Steep Hill Climb
hook: What happens when you climb a steep hill?

beats.label: 1KM
beats.line: 1KM: Your breathing quickens, lungs draw in more air.
beats.idea: Close-up of chest expanding, animated lungs inflating.

beats.label: 2KM
beats.line: 2KM: Your heart beats faster, pumping blood to your legs.
beats.idea: Heart icon beating, red flow moving to leg muscles.

beats.label: 3KM
beats.line: 3KM: Sweat beads form, cooling your skin as you push onward.
beats.idea: Sweat droplets on forehead, cooling breeze effect.

beats.label: 4KM
beats.line: 4KM: Muscles burn as lactic acid builds, intensifying the strain.
beats.idea: Muscles glowing red, small fire icons indicating burn.

beats.label: 5KM
beats.line: 5KM: Core temperature rises, and dehydration makes you feel light‑headed.
beats.idea: Heat waves around character, dizzy swirl effect.

description: A playful animation shows how the body reacts step‑by‑step while climbing a steep hill.

facts.claim: Breathing rate increases during uphill walking
Heart rate rises to pump more blood to muscles during steep ascent
Sweating intensifies to regulate body temperature during exercise
Lactic acid accumulates in muscles causing a burning sensation during intense effort
Body temperature can rise and mild light‑headedness may occur as oxygen demand increases

topic: What happens if you climb a steep hill?
